response.reasoning: The claim matches the data presented in Table 5 of the SURPASS‑2 study: the 10 mg and 15 mg doses of MOUNJARO produced a statistically significant greater reduction in HbA1c at week 40 versus semaglutide 1 mg, with differences of –0.4 % (95 % CI –0.5 to –0.3) and –0.5 % (95 % CI –0.6 to –0.3) respectively, and a p‑value <0.01 for superiority. All elements of the claim (population, doses, time point, statistical significance) are explicitly stated in the excerpts.
